raw_response:
This plot is only a small piece — 0.05 hectares is like my backyard plot. I will not buy chemical fertilizer for it because one bag of NPK costs too much and is too much for this small land; I will spread manure from my compound on the mounds instead, like I did last season. I have my own cassava cuttings saved from last year, so I do not need to pay for improved seed, and I will clear and weed it myself with my family since it is not big enough to hire anyone. We do not irrigate here in the Guinea Savanna — we wait for the rains — and I do not spray chemicals on tubers.
